invoice (distinct_count 2330) and stockcode (distinct_count 3141) are both fully populated required columns; together they plausibly identify one line item per invoice and should be verified against the warehouse before approval.
customer_id has null_rate 0.29778 (null_count 13468 of 45228); nulls are retained rather than imputed since the business meaning of a missing customer is unknown.
description has null_rate 0.005041 (null_count 228); the sparse nulls are retained rather than dropped or imputed.

_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are all flagged is_airbyte_metadata true and carry no business meaning, so they are dropped.

purpose: This table provides cleaned, line-item-level online retail transaction data (invoice, product, quantity, price, customer, and country) intended to feed downstream sales, returns, and customer analytics.
usage: Consumers should treat each row as one invoice-stockcode line item, filter on the is_return flag when excluding returns from revenue calculations, and expect customer_id to be null for roughly 30% of rows representing guest or unidentified purchases.
limitations: Exact duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.011188) are removed but near-duplicates or clock-drift duplicates are not addressed; customer_id remains null for about 29.8% of rows and description is null for about 0.5% of rows, both retained rather than imputed; the invoice-stockcode grain is a plausible candidate pending verification against the live warehouse.
